title: Beware
text: Beware. The top mitered piece of the box (not the door) was not even attached to the rest of the unit. Quality is absolutely not to the standard that I would ever accept and I strongly recommend anyone who is considering this box to read the negative reviews. That are consistent with my experience. Caveat Emptor.
